description: Phase 3.5 — Retire OPERATOR_SECRET_KEY_HEX; derive SPS-50 commit/reveal internal key from Admin Wallet seed at m/86'/0'/73'/2/0

steps.name: derive_commit_reveal_keypair helper
steps.description: Create infrastructure/admin_wallet/commit_reveal_key.rs with pub(crate) derive_commit_reveal_keypair(mnemonic, network) -> Result<UntweakedKeypair, AdminWalletError>. Uses bip39::Mnemonic -> seed -> Xpriv::new_master -> derive_priv at m/86h/0h/73h/2/0 -> SecretKey -> UntweakedKeypair. No BDK wallet, no descriptors.
acceptance_criteria: Happy path: derive_commit_reveal_keypair(TEST_MNEMONIC, Regtest) returns Ok(keypair) and XOnlyPublicKey hex matches a pinned constant
Invalid mnemonic: empty string returns Err(AdminWalletError::InvalidMnemonic(...))
Invalid mnemonic: malformed phrase returns Err(AdminWalletError::InvalidMnemonic(...))
Network agnostic: keypair from Regtest and Bitcoin have the same secret key bytes
Defensive: 100 repeated calls with TEST_MNEMONIC never return Err(AdminWalletError::Descriptor(...))

steps.name: BroadcastEnvError + rewrite load_broadcast_env
steps.description: Rewrite broadcast_env.rs: (1) Add BroadcastEnvError thiserror enum with variants MissingEnv, InvalidNetwork, InvalidMagicBytes, MnemonicSigningDisabled, AdminWallet(#[from] AdminWalletError). (2) Rewrite load_broadcast_env -> Result<BroadcastEnv, BroadcastEnvError>: read ADMIN_WALLET_REGTEST_MNEMONIC, enforce ALLOW_DEV_MNEMONIC_SIGNING=1, call derive_commit_reveal_keypair. (3) Remove OPERATOR_SECRET_KEY_HEX, ALLOW_DEV_OPERATOR_KEY, WELL_KNOWN_TEST_OPERATOR_KEY_HEX, parse_operator_keypair, reject_well_known_operator_key_unless_dev and their tests. (4) BroadcastEnv field operator_keypair renamed to commit_reveal_keypair.
acceptance_criteria: Happy path: all required env vars set returns BroadcastEnv with commit_reveal_keypair matching derive_commit_reveal_keypair output for same mnemonic
Missing mnemonic: ALLOW_DEV_MNEMONIC_SIGNING=1 but no ADMIN_WALLET_REGTEST_MNEMONIC returns BroadcastEnvError::MissingEnv
Missing guard: mnemonic set but ALLOW_DEV_MNEMONIC_SIGNING unset returns BroadcastEnvError::MnemonicSigningDisabled
Guard false: ALLOW_DEV_MNEMONIC_SIGNING=0 returns BroadcastEnvError::MnemonicSigningDisabled
Invalid mnemonic: AdminWalletError::InvalidMnemonic propagated as BroadcastEnvError::AdminWallet
Regression: BITCOIN_MAGIC_BYTES_HEX, BITCOIN_NETWORK, BITCOIN_WALLET_NAME, BROADCAST_CONFIRM_POLL_MS, BROADCAST_CONFIRM_TIMEOUT_MS all parsed correctly
Regression: invalid BITCOIN_MAGIC_BYTES_HEX (3 bytes) returns BroadcastEnvError::InvalidMagicBytes

steps.name: Pinned commit address integration test
steps.description: Add integration-style test in commit_reveal_key.rs (or a dedicated test module): wire derive_commit_reveal_keypair(TEST_MNEMONIC, Regtest) into broadcast_tx::derive_commit_address with a fixed payload byte literal. Assert the resulting commit address string equals a constant pinned in the test. This is the long-term regression hook against derivation drift.
acceptance_criteria: derive_commit_address called with keypair from TEST_MNEMONIC + fixed payload returns a pinned, stable address string
The pinned constant is committed in the test (not computed at runtime)

steps.name: Wiring: mod.rs re-export + call site rename
steps.description: Update infrastructure/admin_wallet/mod.rs to re-export derive_commit_reveal_keypair. Update commands/proposals.rs: rename env.operator_keypair -> env.commit_reveal_keypair at both call sites. Update application/proposals.rs: parameter naming only (signatures unchanged). Ensure cargo build compiles cleanly.
acceptance_criteria: cargo build succeeds with zero errors
grep operator_keypair desktop-app/src-tauri/src/ returns zero hits
commands/proposals.rs uses env.commit_reveal_keypair at proposals_prepare_broadcast and proposals_broadcast call sites

steps.name: Cleanup: env, docs, scripts, CI

grep -r ALLOW_DEV_OPERATOR_KEY . --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=docs/assessment returns zero hits
